entry.notRun: no `gh` process, no network; the cwd is the process cwd (the repo inference reads its response from the scripted run)
entry.runs: src/runtime/github/contract.mjs, commands.mjs, client.mjs (executeGithubRequest), tool.mjs (executeGithubTool), the builtin registry (executeBuiltinTool/isBuiltinTool) and tool-classify _isMutationTool, with the process runner `run` scripted (the injection point the tests use)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.entry: mixdog-scm gh/client.rs and mixdog-tools github: drive the same request/tool calls with the recorded scripted runner responses and compare the commands built (args, stdin, mutation), the results/errors and the tool text whole (and raw files)

normalised.cwd: the process cwd is not recorded
normalised.tempDirs: temp dirs (clone destinations, data dirs, raw file paths) are <tmp>/<data>; a replay must substitute its own and compare the rest
